weaknesses: Oracles are vague; no concrete value checks

Boundary tests lack exact boundary values (e.g., -4cm, 5cm, 55cm, 1breath, 0breath, 100breath)
No verification of actual measured values (PEEP, PIP, breath rate) against targets
